answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization aims to generate a succinct summary while retaining essential information of the dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE and BERTScore for evaluating our models.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of the dialogue summary to assess its informativeness, conciseness and coverage. ... We have 4 human evaluators and they were asked to rate each summary on a scale of 1 to 5 (higher is better) for each metric.
answer_4.guideline: Rate summaries on informativeness, conciseness, and coverage using a scale of 1 to 5.
